verdict.rationale: Extend documents its own webhook system. A Webhook Configuration page covers setting up webhooks in the dashboard or via the API, subscribing to global events, and workflow-specific subscriptions. Webhooks are also positioned for async production workloads, with test-mode keys isolated from production webhooks. missing for 10: documented event-type catalog and payload schemas, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
